items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I studied with him for a while

ctx.x: Now, in several biographical sketches about you, you mention 2 people in particular quite often; one was a man that you referred to as Mr. Michaels, and another one by the name of Arthur Reeves, and I'm wondering if you could tell us, first of all, about Mr. Michaels. Do you remember his first name?
Yes, his name I believe, was Eugene Michael ... Lieutenant Eugene Michael, and I think he'd been
the leader of a band; you know, in World War 1.
